lists.name: RYM Top — Rock — Garage Rock Revival

podcast.body: Launched the year after their debut, this album maintained the band's primitive, low-fi, and raw sound. While it did not make much noise outside the underground scene, it was very well-received by critics, further solidifying their promising sound. "De style lanzado al año siguiente, mantenía ese sonido primitivo, low-fi y de sonido trabajo."

srcs.episode: Por qué White Stripes desaparecieron en su mejor momento?

podcast.body: The single "Hay Operator," which had a studio version of "Jolene" as its B-side, was taken from this album. "In 2000, a studio version showed up as a B-side of a single called Hay Operator, which came from the Distill album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album was released in 2000 and gained early attention, particularly from England, with it being recommended in London's Notting Hill Rough Trade Records as current and cool. "This is what everybody is writing about mate and they're from your neck of the woods too."
